title: STRANGLER-IPU — Ingress Processing Unit Architecture
bullets: Ingress-Aware Boundary Computing Architecture: Near-memory hardware accelerator subsystem targeting 6G Sub-THz line-rate ingest (800 Gbps – 1.6 Tbps burst) and AI boundary inference, eliminating host DRAM memory-wall contention through decoupled front-end ingress offload
